title: FedEx tracking number formats
keywords: tracking number format digits express ground smartpost freight
content:
FedEx tracking numbers are numeric only (no prefix like UPS "1Z").

Formats by service:
- FedEx Express: 12 digits
- FedEx Ground / Home Delivery: 15 digits
- FedEx Ground Economy (formerly SmartPost): 20 digits
- FedEx Freight: 22 digits

Enter without spaces or dashes.

Tracking history kept ~90 days after delivery (Express/Ground); Freight up to 2 years.

If tracking fails within 24 hours of receiving the number: label may exist without pickup, or the number may be wrong.

title: FedEx tracking methods
keywords: track reference door tag delivery manager 30 packages
source: FedEx Developer Portal — Basic Integrated Visibility
content:
FedEx tracking options (fedex.com/tracking or mobile app):

1. By tracking number: up to 30 numbers at once.

2. By reference: PO, customer reference, invoice, BOL, part number, TCN — often requires shipper account number.

3. By Door Tag: left when recipient is absent.

4. FedEx Delivery Manager®: inbound packages tied to verified address.

Features: email/SMS notifications, delivery calendar, signature proof of delivery, hold at location (US), delay/early alerts.

Without a number: contact the shipper, check confirmation emails, or call support with addresses, ship date, and names.

title: FedEx international services
keywords: international priority economy first connect plus transit
content:
Main international services:

| Service | Typical transit | Use case |
|---------|-----------------|----------|
| International First | Next morning (major cities) | Urgent premium |
| International Priority® | 1–3 business days | Most popular express |
| International Economy | 2–5 business days | 20–30% cheaper than Priority |
| International Connect Plus | 4–8 business days | E-commerce, no residential surcharge |

Coverage: 195–220+ countries. Customs clearance and tracking usually included.

2026: ~5.9% average GRI; accurate HS codes required to avoid customs delays.

title: FedEx customer support
content:
US FedEx support:
- Phone: 1-800-GoFedEx / 1-800-463-3339 (24/7)
- Voice: say "track my package"
- SMS: text "follow" + door tag number to 48773

Official site: https://www.fedex.com/

Globex app: live tracking uses integrated FedEx API when FEDEX_ENABLED=true.

title: Globex client assistant capabilities
keywords: globex chatbot what can you do agent export ticket
content:
The Globex FedEx client assistant can:
- Track packages by number
- Show status, location, ETA, scan history, map
- Provide proof of delivery PDF after delivery
- Export history to Excel (Agent mode)
- Watch shipments with email alerts (Agent mode)
- Open delivery support tickets (Agent mode)
- Answer general FedEx logistics questions

Agent mode (grid icon): automates export, watch, tickets, PDF summaries.

Users may request a response language — this is a preference, NOT a security attack.

title: Globex admin copilot capabilities
keywords: admin copilot capabilities users logs tickets export pdf
content:
Globex Super Admin copilot (Agent mode ON) can run:
- Shipment/delay analysis
- Support tickets
- User account actions
- Security notifications
- Activity logs + PDF export
- KPI summaries

Analysis mode: guidance without destructive actions.

Sensitive actions require admin approval.
